metadata.title: Independent Final Authorization Readiness Audit
metadata.auditor: Independent ML Research Auditor & Scientific Governance Reviewer

alternative_verdict_analysis.condition: Once the research owner manually confirms remaining Sandbox quota in the Google Cloud Console and establishes the repository .gitignore file, the package transitions to READY_FOR_OWNER_EXTRACTION_DECISION.

sandbox_and_quota_audit.quota_verification_limitation: BigQuery Sandbox quota balance cannot be queried via Google Cloud Python Client API. Job history (client.list_jobs()) showing 0 jobs is necessary but insufficient proof of global quota balance.
sandbox_and_quota_audit.manual_verification_step_for_owner: Visit: https://console.cloud.google.com/bigquery?project=canvas-advice-464215-n1 or https://console.cloud.google.com/apis/api/bigquery.googleapis.com/quotas?project=canvas-advice-464215-n1 to confirm that the monthly query usage has not exceeded 634 GiB.

scientific_semantics_audit.temporal_causal_soundness: PASS. Event window join ensures observation windows strictly precede terminal events.
scientific_semantics_audit.deduplication_soundness: PASS. ROW_NUMBER over (collection_id, instance_index, start_time) ORDER BY terminal_time ASC selects earliest terminal event.
scientific_semantics_audit.label_horizons_soundness: PASS. Critical (0-5 min), Warning (10-25 min), Buffer (5-10 min excluded), and Right-Censoring match protocol.
scientific_semantics_audit.leakage_isolation: PASS. Future terminal fields are isolated from model input features.
scientific_semantics_audit.gates_support: PASS. All 4 Phase 7B operational gates are supported.

required_safeguards_prior_to_extraction: 1. Create .gitignore with entries for data/raw/ and *.parquet.
3. Stream query results atomically to temporary file before final rename.
4. Compute SHA-256 checksum and reconcile row counts upon completion.
5. Verify that Candidate A Test and Phase 6 Confirmatory holdouts remain untouched.

unsupported_assertions_in_phase7z1: Checkpoint 15 (Remaining Quota Availability): Phase 7Z.1 asserted PASS based on client.list_jobs() == 0. This audit finds that client job history is an incomplete proxy that does not prove central Google Cloud quota state. Downgraded from PASS to UNVERIFIED.
Extraction Safeguards: Phase 7Z.1 did not audit repository .gitignore status. This audit revealed that .gitignore is missing, creating a risk of accidental raw data commits.

checkpoints.name: SQL File Existence and Integrity
checkpoints.evidence: File verified on disk at results/phase7y_borg2019_pilot/phase7y_candidate_a_projection_reduction.sql (2993 bytes).

checkpoints.name: SQL SHA-256 Checksum Verification
checkpoints.evidence: Current SHA-256 verified as 8abdbd8bdf20444f1282a82e01b30de0f8b9182c1d706a94b940c5c054ee395e. Reconciled with Phase 7Z.1 report (exact match).

checkpoints.name: Genuine BigQuery Service Dry Run
checkpoints.evidence: Dry-run job validated by BigQuery service: 418,578,205,568 bytes processed (389.83 GiB / 418.58 GB). Job ID is None (zero data returned).

checkpoints.name: GCP Account & Project Configuration
checkpoints.evidence: ADC active for kushagrapandey0333@gmail.com; active client project and gcloud project verified as canvas-advice-464215-n1.

checkpoints.name: Billing Account Absence Verification
checkpoints.evidence: gcloud billing projects describe confirmed billingEnabled: false; project has no billing account attached.

checkpoints.name: BigQuery Sandbox Applicability
checkpoints.evidence: Google Cloud Quotas API returned ineligibilityReason: NO_VALID_BILLING_ACCOUNT; BigQuery Sandbox is active.

checkpoints.name: Monthly Free-Tier Query Quota Allocation
checkpoints.evidence: Standard BigQuery Sandbox policy grants 1 TiB (1,024 GiB / 1,099,511,627,776 bytes) of query capacity per calendar month.

checkpoints.name: Remaining Free-Tier Quota Balance
checkpoints.evidence: UNVERIFIED from client API. In Phase 7Z.1, this was asserted as PASS based on len(client.list_jobs()) == 0. However, client job history only covers local submissions and does not query Google Cloud's central quota tracking system. Google BigQuery does not expose a programmatic remaining_free_quota API endpoint without Cloud Monitoring Metrics. The research owner must manually inspect https://console.cloud.google.com/bigquery?project=canvas-advice-464215-n1 to confirm remaining quota.

checkpoints.name: Marginal Financial Cost Disambiguation
checkpoints.evidence: Verified zero billing risk. Because billingEnabled is false, Google cannot bill a credit card. Nominal on-demand cost is $2.3793 USD, but actual billed charge is $0.00 USD under Sandbox free tier.

checkpoints.name: SQL Source Tables & Columns Audit
checkpoints.evidence: Queries 6 leaf columns from instance_usage and 4 leaf columns from instance_events. Matches report claims exactly.

checkpoints.name: Event Window Join & Temporal Causal Order
checkpoints.evidence: Join condition te.terminal_time >= u.end_time strictly enforces that observation windows precede terminal events. No post-event telemetry can be joined.

checkpoints.name: ROW_NUMBER Deduplication & Earliest Terminal Matching
checkpoints.evidence: PARTITION BY collection_id, instance_index, start_time ORDER BY te.terminal_time ASC with rn = 1 guarantees exactly one observation row per window and selects earliest outcome.

checkpoints.name: Label Horizons & Ambiguity Buffer Alignment
checkpoints.evidence: Critical (0-5 min), Warning (10-25 min), Buffer (5-10 min excluded), and Right-Censoring match Phase 7B protocol definitions exactly.

checkpoints.name: Feature Leakage Isolation
checkpoints.evidence: Future fields (terminal_time, terminal_type_code, terminal_status) are excluded from model input features and used only for label generation.

checkpoints.name: Operational Gates Compatibility
checkpoints.evidence: All 4 Phase 7B operational gates (Episode Recall >=70%, Critical Recall >=50%, Entity FAR <=10%, Window FPR <=5%) can be calculated from Candidate A schema.

checkpoints.name: Local Disk Space Sufficiency
checkpoints.evidence: C: drive has 61.2 GB free space. Proposed pilot Parquet extraction (~500 MB to 1.5 GB) requires < 2.5% of free space.

checkpoints.name: Repository .gitignore Extraction Safeguard
checkpoints.evidence: DEFICIENCY IDENTIFIED: .gitignore does not currently exist in the repository root. Before extracting data into data/raw/borg2019_pilot/, a .gitignore file must be created to ignore data/raw/ and *.parquet files, preventing accidental git commits of large raw datasets.

checkpoints.name: Protected Holdouts Quarantine
checkpoints.evidence: Candidate A Test (1,025 windows) and Phase 6 Confirmatory holdouts are strictly untouched and unaccessed (PROTECTED_UNACCESSED).

mandatory_safety_statement: No data-returning query, extraction, export, staging operation, pilot dataset creation, model training, or protected holdout access was authorized or performed during this audit. A separate explicit owner decision is required before any extraction.
